claims: White is pronounced /(h)wīt/.
White is the lightest color.
White is created by reflecting all visible light.
White is created by combining red, green, and blue light.
Common shades of white include bright white, cream, ivory, and off-white.
Pure/Stark White has maximum brightness with no undertones.
Warm Whites contain yellow or red-brown undertones.
Cotton White is a warm white.
Ivory is a warm white.
Cream is a warm white.
Cool Whites have slight blue or gray undertones.
Off-White is a subtle, softer alternative to pure white.
In Western cultures, white symbolizes purity, innocence, and peace.
White is frequently used in weddings in Western cultures.
In many Eastern cultures (e.g., India, China), white is associated with death, mourning, and purity.
Experts suggest that people with warm complexions look better in cream or butter-white.
Experts suggest that people with cool complexions suit starker whites.
The opposite of white is black.
Black absorbs all light.
White reflects all light.
White coffee is coffee containing milk or cream.
In chess and checkers, white pieces are light-colored.
In chess and checkers, white pieces often start.
